title: begonia alpina
intro: Begonia alpina, commonly known as Begonia x hybrida 'Alpina', is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Begoniaceae family. This plant is valued for its air-purifying properties, with health benefits including reducing stress and anxiety, while also promoting better sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Begonia alpina are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
